title: Chiller Minimum-Run and Anti-Recycle Timing
description: Runs Chiller-1 through a normal start, an early stop request held by the local minimum-run controller, and an immediate restart request blocked until minimum-off and startup proof timing both complete.

events.description: Request an immediate restart during minimum-off
Request final normal stop after second-start evidence

expected_results: Operating State moves from starting (2) to running (3) after the 45-second proof delay
The early stop command becomes inactive while status remains active and Minimum Run Hold is true
After the unit stops, the restart command remains active while Anti-Recycle is true and Minimum Off Remaining counts down
The second proof occurs only after minimum-off and a new startup delay; Start Count reaches two
completion_criteria: Student distinguishes the WebCTRL start request from the local controller's effective state and proof
Student explains why a safety trip would still override the minimum-run hold immediately
instructor_notes: Run at 10x for about one minute. State codes are numeric AV telemetry because multi-state BACnet objects are not implemented. STOP or restore the baseline after the evidence window to release instructor priorities.
student_objectives: Interpret minimum-run and anti-recycle behavior from commands, state, timers, proof, and start count
Avoid diagnosing intentional OEM protection as a failed start command
